notes: UE5 LWC UpdateCamera cache writes via movups [rsi],xmm0 + movups [rsi+10],xmm1 with an interleaved movsd load from [rbp-disp8]. Location.X+Y and Location.Z+Rot.Pitch covered. Yaw/Roll/FOV are written elsewhere and currently NOT blocked here; add additional intercepts when those sites are mapped. Site 0 (xy) anchor is not robust enough to be unique with pure wildcard -- confirm address via __cam_intercept_list and compare RVA against site 1.

camera_write_profile._comment: UE5 has find_cam_pov which sets g_cam_pov_ptr. Trajectory playback uses that path, not this profile's offsets. Kept here for reference.
